lines.beaver_en: Could you explain last night's incident?
lines.en: Yes, I'll answer as the lead investigator.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of incident was it?
lines.learner: 강도 두 명이 약국 창고에서 마약류를 훔쳤습니다.
lines.en: Two robbers stole narcotics from a pharmacy storeroom.
lines.roman: Gangdo du myeongi yakguk changgoeseo mayangnyureul humchyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: I heard there was a fire too.
lines.learner: 네, 범인들이 불을 질러서 소방차가 왔습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the criminals set a fire, so fire trucks came.
lines.roman: Ne, beomindeuri bureul jilleoseo sobangchaga watseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: And the criminals? Were they caught?
lines.learner: 한 명은 잡았지만 한 명은 도망갔습니다.
lines.en: We caught one, but the other ran away.
lines.roman: Han myeongeun jabatjiman han myeongeun domanggatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Where did the one who escaped go?
lines.en: He fled toward a nearby army unit.

lines.beaver_en: Did the military base help too?
lines.learner: 네, 부대에서 감시 카메라 영상을 주었습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the unit gave us surveillance camera footage.
lines.roman: Ne, budaeeseo gamsi kamera yeongsangeul jueotseumnida.

lines.learner: 범인이 군인들을 칼로 위협했지만 곧 잡혔습니다.
lines.en: He threatened soldiers with a knife but was soon caught.
lines.roman: Beomini gunindeureul kallo wihyeopaetjiman got japyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of person is the criminal?
lines.learner: 다음 달에 입대할 예정인 스무 살 남자입니다.
lines.en: A 20-year-old man due to enlist next month.
lines.roman: Daeum dare ipdaehal yejeongin seumu sal namjaimnida.

lines.beaver_en: Will you keep cooperating with the military base?
lines.en: Yes, we will increase patrols together with the military.

lines.learner: 군사 지역 주변도 경찰이 계속 감시하겠습니다.
lines.en: Police will keep watching areas around military zones.
lines.roman: Gunsa jiyeok jubyeondo gyeongchari gyesok gamsihagetseumnida.
